name: Open port 80/tcp - http
description: HTTP service running Apache 2.4.25 (Debian). Hosts the DVWA practice application.
solution: Keep the web server patched; this is the primary attack surface.

name: Open port 3306/tcp - mysql
description: MySQL 5.7.33 is exposed. If reachable from untrusted networks this significantly widens the attack surface.
solution: Bind MySQL to localhost only and firewall port 3306 from untrusted networks.

name: Open port 22/tcp - ssh
description: OpenSSH 7.4 is running. Older SSH versions may have known weaknesses.
solution: Restrict SSH access, use key-based auth, and keep OpenSSH updated.
